notes.title: 11th September Update
notes.content:
[p][b][u]Dedicated Server update for QOL[/u][/b][/p][p]Added the ability to set each Server Name when launching dedicated servers[/p][p]Each Dedicated Server displays with a different Server name in Steam Game Servers, and the same names apply to the Server Browser in-game

[b][u]Changes to Hunger and Thirst[/u][/b][/p][p]Reduced Hunger/Thirst tick rates. Hunger/Thirst are now much more manageable[/p][p]Instead of Hunger/thirst ticking down 1% every 5-6 seconds it now ticks 1% every 14-15 seconds

[b][u]UI Updates[/u][/b][/p][p]Adjusted UI to display all inventory slots without the need to scroll[/p][p]Reduced starting slots to 20 (From 24)[/p][p]Adjusted additional inventory slots added by equipping Pants, Hoodies Backpacks & Vests[/p][p]Maximum inventory slots available by equipped gear are now 48

[b][u]Bug Fixes/Changes[/u][/b][/p][p]Fixed rotation and location of placeable storage chest lid, it now opens and closes correctly[/p][p]Adjusted respawn time of all AI to 5mins

[b][u]Map Updates[/u][/b][/p][p]Added 5 x variations of Military Zombie to Military Base[/p][p]Military Zombie has More HP, provides more exp and skill exp on kill and drops Ammo, Ranged Weapons and a large amount of Zomcoin[/p][p]More risk = more reward
[/p][p]Added Loot Spawners inside Swanfield Police Station in a number of locations
[/p][p]Added 3 x Variations of Zombie Police surrounding Swanfield Police Station[/p][p]The same settings as Military Zombies apply to Police Zombies, more HP, higher value loot, more exp gain[/p][p]Added Military Zombie spawns near Swanfield Police Station also[/p]

notes.title: Dedicated Server Support & Bug Fixes/Changes
notes.content:
[p][u][b]Engine Change & Dedicated Server Support [/b][/u][/p][p]Switched Engine to use Unreal Engine Source Build for Dedicated Server Support[/p][p]Dedicated servers now function correctly, any LIVE servers display in Steam/Game Servers, and also in-game to connect to dedicated via Lobby[/p][p]Players now have 2 x options:-
[/p][p]1 Enter Lobby and Host a session with a group of 5 (Player plus 4 x Steam Friends)[/p][p]2 Enter Lobby and connect directly to a dedicated server that hosts (for now) Up to 50 x players  
[/p][p]Fixed (Still monitoring) a crash when player dies and enters the knockout screen[/p][p]There was an issue with the player being destroyed and animation resetting in ragdoll, when respawning the engine/game would crash with Assertion Failed error.[/p][p]Tested in editor and in Game and so far the code changes have fixed it, but still needs more testing
[/p][p][b][u]Changes/Bug Fixes[/u][/b]

Added 4 x Motels with 9 x rooms in each, car parking and front/back offices[/p][p]Painted road/asphalt materials to entrance/exit and through housing areas[/p][p]Added Axe/Pickaxe animations when using Axe on Trees, and Pickaxe on Rocks[/p][p][/p][p]Switched Plug-ins to spawn, destroy and optimize AI based on Player location. Now also working correctly following Death/respawn of the player
Currently set to debug in-game to test (Purple spheres will display when AI despawn)
Debug and spheres will be removed in a future update[/p][p][/p][p]Modified Zomcoin prices for buying and selling items[/p][p]Added 4 x Vendors to each Safe Zone. Vendors now have 4 x individual shop lists for items to buy (Weapons/Ammo, Armour, Food/Drink, Resources)[/p][p]Added every lootable item to Vendors for Selling player loot.[/p][p]Fixed Safezone Guard AI, they now move and patrol the guard towers in each safezone[/p][p]Guards with NOT attack players, they will attack all other AI
Players can damage guards, however Health has been increased to combat this for now
Also added blocking to guard tower to not exploit with melee weapons[/p][p]Zombies are now blocked from entering Safezones[/p][p]Animal AI will roam inside Safezones and will attack (Bears), but not cause player damage[/p][p][/p][p]All AI are now blocked from entering Water[/p][p]Increased Hostile Ranged AI damage, accuracy and range[/p][p]Increased AI Guard damage, accuracy and range[/p][p]Changed Online session info - Sessions now display the player name that created the session to join to.[/p][p]Changed UI showing how online sessions are displayed, changed colour scheme to match and added hover sounds to exit buttons.[/p]

notes.title: 22nd August bug fixes and changes made following Live Stream
notes.content:
[p][b][u]Bug Fixes & content updates[/u][/b][/p][p]Fixed clothing clipping, still monitoring but from initial testing it "Seems" fixed,[/p][p]Weapon Attachments now attach correctly,[/p][p]1st person no longer toggles in Upgrade Weapon mode,[/p][p]Wetness/Puddles displaying correctly on a number of materials and surfaces,[/p][p]Added ADS offsets for Male & Female character when applying and removing scopes to weapons,[/p][p]Adjusted Berry values again (Nerfed too much) They now replenish slightly more Hunger & Thirst,[/p][p]Player now starts with a random T-Shirt, Pants and Shoes equipped (Random every start, random every death/respawn)
[/p][p][b][u]New items added[/u][/b][/p][p]Holoscope, Silencer, Flashlight sockets and offsets to Rifles,[/p][p]2 x New Scar Rifles (Desert & Camo Skin),[/p][p]Campfires to Campsites,[/p][p]Climbable collision to multiple models to allow climbing,[/p][p]More foliage to map in areas where it was sparse,[/p][p]Melting effect of Snow surrounding campfire when lit. Snow now melts away, and returns when Campfire is no longer lit,[/p][p]10 x Different type of Male & Female Ranged AI to Raider Camps[/p][p]2 x Safezones with NPC Traders,[/p][p]Friendly Ranged AI Guards (They attack all AI, do not attack Players)[b][u]

Additional found bugs and Fixes applied [/u][/b] 

Fixed projectile collision and materials on Campfire[/p][p]Fixed AK47 showing crosshair in FP ADS[/p][p]Fixed Tree stump LOD distances (trunk material no longer spams out)[/p][p]Fixed LOD distances on Farm buildings[/p][p]Fixed Farm storage tent collision blocking players[/p][p]Fixed missing inventory items for Shoes, Boots, Trainers & Repair Bench[/p][p]Fixed Car repair wrench UI text & description, changed Car repair wrench equipped model & adjusted player held location[/p][p]Updated all crafting recipes for Player, Workbench & Table Saw

[u][b]Added to game content[/b][/u][/p][p]Added Climbable collision to Farm Pallet Stacks[/p][p]Added replicated sound effect for Safe Zone gates open/close[/p][p]Added Raw Meat & Intestines to loot from Pigs[/p][p]Added Raw Meat & Animal Skin to loot from Bears & Deer[/p][p]Added Chicken Leg, Feathers & Eggs to loot from Chickens[/p][p]Added Table Saw and crafting recipes to craft wood Placeable Buildings[/p][p]Added PigPen and Chicken Coop to craftable items[/p][p]Added Spiked Bat and Crowbar recipes to Crafting Workbench[/p][p]Adjusted Rifle Recoil in FP ADS and with Holoscope attached (Recoil was too high)[/p][p]Adjusted Player temperature damage to below 5ºc and above 35ºc (Adjustment made because player now starts with clothing equipped)[/p][p]Adjusted Smoke grenade colour, scale and duration[/p][p]Adjusted explosion Niagara effects[/p][p]Adjusted on-screen damage and critical damage colour display

[u][b]General changes[/b][/u][/p][p]Reduced sound that plays on ranged weapon equip[/p][p]Reduced building saw sound when placing[/p][p]Increased Campfire storage to 16 slots[/p][p]Increased Ranged AI sight distance, shot accuracy & weapon range[/p][p]Increased all placeable buildings Health and Repair amounts[/p][p]Changed names on military loot crates[/p][p]Changed Grenade explosion effect, sound and duration[/p][p]Changed throwable arc colour[/p][p]Changed explosive barrel destroyed colour and effect[/p][p]Changed raider camp air drop chest reward, sounds and smoke effect[/p][p]Changed PlotPole building radius to 50m[/p][p]Changed Repair Bench model, Repair Bench UI and added all Melee & Ranged weapons to repair options in exchange for Zomcoin[/p]
